items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Yeah. Used to go around and play dances and all like that when I was playing with him.

ctx.x: And then back by the waterworks sometime. Yeah, back there, well that's the Elks. Oh yeah, the Elks. That's the Elks back there. Uh-huh. Yeah, that's where the Elks home is back there. Uh-huh.
Well when you played with, uh, with Sonny Allen, did y'all play inside or outside mostly? With Sonny Allen. What, what you mean with Little Allen? Yeah, with Little Allen.

Well we used to play dances and things. Yeah. Used to go around and play dances and all like that when I was playing with him. Would that be in the halls or would it be in the... Be in the halls, yeah. Like back at the Turtle Park and Circuit Arts Hall and up in McDonaville, at the, at the McDonaville Hall to play up there. What about picnics over here? Well we used to go out on picnics too like that, go out and play picnics like that. Play truck rides, going to different towns like that. Like, sometimes they…
